Class SpeciesPresetManager

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.client.ui.SpeciesPresetManager
public class SpeciesPresetManager extends Object
Manages Species presets: built-in biological defaults + user custom presets. Persists presets to species_presets.json in the working directory.
